title: Arithmetic geometry of quantum connections on Calabi-Yau $3$-folds
summary: Fix a prime $p > 3$. Working over $\mathbb{Z}_p$, we show that the quantum connection of any closed Calabi-Yau threefold gives rise to a Fontaine-Laffaile module when restricted to the even degree and torsion-free part of $p$-adic quantum cohomology, whose associated Frobenius endomorphism has leading order term prescribed by the $p$-adic Gamma class. After reducing mod $p$, the divided Frobenius endomorphism defines an analogue of the inverse Cartier operator on mod $p$ quantum cohomology.
